name: Memcached
description: High-performance distributed memory cache — handy backing service for other self-hosted apps. Headless: no web UI.
compose:
services:
  memcached:
    image: memcached:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.mem_port}}:11211"
    command: -m ${{cfg.memory_mb}}
    restart: unless-stopped
